presentation.description: Complete 20.83 km Nordschleife from OSM survey data with real elevation (289 m range). Widths, curbs, runoff and scenery are approximations.
presentation.source: OpenStreetMap raceway centreline (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL); elevation: lower of EU-DEM 25 m and SRTM 30 m via OpenTopoData, median + 60 m smoothing, effective vertical radius ~400 m
